panels.description: Live commits / rollbacks / deadlocks per second, per-interval delta of pg_stat_database summed across DBs (telemetry.pg_stat_db, nova_pg_stat_poller).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ts, datname,
    (xact_commit - lag(xact_commit) OVER w) AS d_xact_commit,
    (xact_rollback - lag(xact_rollback) OVER w) AS d_xact_rollback,
    (deadlocks - lag(deadlocks) OVER w) AS d_deadlocks,
    extract(epoch FROM ts - lag(ts) OVER w) AS secs
  FROM telemetry.pg_stat_db
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY datname ORDER BY ts)
)
SELECT ts AS time, 'commits/s' AS metric, sum(d_xact_commit/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_xact_commit >= 0 GROUP BY ts
UNION ALL
SELECT ts AS time, 'rollbacks/s' AS metric, sum(d_xact_rollback/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_xact_rollback >= 0 GROUP BY ts
UNION ALL
SELECT ts AS time, 'deadlocks/s' AS metric, sum(d_deadlocks/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_deadlocks >= 0 GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Transaction rate

panels.description: Live rows inserted / updated / deleted per second (per-interval delta, summed across DBs).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ts, datname,
    (tup_inserted - lag(tup_inserted) OVER w) AS d_tup_inserted,
    (tup_updated - lag(tup_updated) OVER w) AS d_tup_updated,
    (tup_deleted - lag(tup_deleted) OVER w) AS d_tup_deleted,
    extract(epoch FROM ts - lag(ts) OVER w) AS secs
  FROM telemetry.pg_stat_db
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY datname ORDER BY ts)
)
SELECT ts AS time, 'inserted/s' AS metric, sum(d_tup_inserted/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_tup_inserted >= 0 GROUP BY ts
UNION ALL
SELECT ts AS time, 'updated/s' AS metric, sum(d_tup_updated/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_tup_updated >= 0 GROUP BY ts
UNION ALL
SELECT ts AS time, 'deleted/s' AS metric, sum(d_tup_deleted/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_tup_deleted >= 0 GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tuple write rate

panels.description: Live rows returned (scanned) / fetched per second (per-interval delta, summed across DBs).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ts, datname,
    (tup_returned - lag(tup_returned) OVER w) AS d_tup_returned,
    (tup_fetched - lag(tup_fetched) OVER w) AS d_tup_fetched,
    extract(epoch FROM ts - lag(ts) OVER w) AS secs
  FROM telemetry.pg_stat_db
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY datname ORDER BY ts)
)
SELECT ts AS time, 'returned/s' AS metric, sum(d_tup_returned/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_tup_returned >= 0 GROUP BY ts
UNION ALL
SELECT ts AS time, 'fetched/s' AS metric, sum(d_tup_fetched/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_tup_fetched >= 0 GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tuple read rate

panels.description: Live buffer cache hits / disk block reads per second (per-interval delta, summed across DBs).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ts, datname,
    (blks_hit - lag(blks_hit) OVER w) AS d_blks_hit,
    (blks_read - lag(blks_read) OVER w) AS d_blks_read,
    extract(epoch FROM ts - lag(ts) OVER w) AS secs
  FROM telemetry.pg_stat_db
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY datname ORDER BY ts)
)
SELECT ts AS time, 'cache hits/s' AS metric, sum(d_blks_hit/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_blks_hit >= 0 GROUP BY ts
UNION ALL
SELECT ts AS time, 'disk reads/s' AS metric, sum(d_blks_read/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_blks_read >= 0 GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY time

  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY datname ORDER BY ts)

SELECT ts AS time, 'temp files/s' AS metric, sum(d_temp_files/secs) AS value
FROM d WHERE secs > 0 AND d_temp_files >= 0 GROUP BY ts

panels.description: One row per connected replica from pg_stat_replication. Lag shown in WAL bytes behind primary.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  client_addr AS "replica",
  application_name AS "app",
  state,
  sync_state AS "sync",
  pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), sent_lsn)   AS "sent lag",
  pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), write_lsn)  AS "write lag",
  pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), flush_lsn)  AS "flush lag",
  pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), replay_lsn) AS "replay lag"
FROM pg_stat_replication ORDER BY client_addr

panels.description: Replay lag in WAL bytes per replica. Amber >1MB, red >64MB.

targets.rawSql:

FROM pg_stat_replication ORDER BY client_addr

panels.description: Client backend queries currently active, longest first. Duration amber >60s, red >5m.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  extract(epoch FROM now()-query_start)::numeric(12,1) AS "duration",
  pid, usename AS "user", datname AS "db", state,
  wait_event_type AS "wait",
  left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 120) AS "query"
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state='active' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND backend_type='client backend'
ORDER BY query_start ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

panels.description: Top tables by total on-disk size (heap + indexes + toast).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  schemaname||'.'||relname AS "table",
  pg_total_relation_size(relid) AS "total",
  pg_table_size(relid)          AS "heap",
  pg_indexes_size(relid)        AS "indexes",
  n_live_tup                    AS "live rows"
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Largest tables

panels.description: Top indexes by on-disk size.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT schemaname||'.'||indexrelname AS idx, pg_relation_size(indexrelid) AS bytes
FROM pg_stat_user_indexes
ORDER BY pg_relation_size(indexrelid) DESC
LIMIT 12

panels.title: Largest indexes

panels.description: Dead-tuple ratio and last (auto)vacuum/analyze per table. High dead % signals bloat / vacuum lag.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  schemaname||'.'||relname AS "table",
  n_live_tup AS "live",
  n_dead_tup AS "dead",
  round(100.0*n_dead_tup/nullif(n_live_tup+n_dead_tup,0),1) AS "dead %",
  last_vacuum AS "last vacuum",
  last_autovacuum AS "last autovacuum",
  last_analyze AS "last analyze",
  last_autoanalyze AS "last autoanalyze"
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
WHERE n_live_tup+n_dead_tup > 0
ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC
LIMIT 25
